blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape , in which the predicted parts are non-overlapping and collectively reconstruct the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder that jointly scores the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods.
Code is available at https://henrytsui000.github.io/Point2Part .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent 3D generative models produce high-quality object-level meshes from a text prompt or a single image ( Li et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, downstream applications such as part-level editing require decomposing these objects into distinct components ( Mo et al., 2019b ; Mo et al., 2019a ) . This has motivated growing interest in part-level 3D generation ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Yet existing part-level methods typically produce a collection of parts that may overlap, without jointly considering whether these parts form a disjoint partition of the entire shape.
blocks.zh: 近期的3D基因模型从文本提示或单一图像中产生高质量的对象级中间体(Li等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2026年;Hunyuan3) D等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年). 然而,分级编辑等下游应用需要将这些对象分解成不同的组件(Mo等人,2019b;Mo等人,2019a). 这促使人们日益关注部分层面的3D生成(Zhu等人,2026a); 杨等,2025). 然而,现有的部分级方法通常会产生可能重叠的部分集合,而不共同考虑这些部分是否构成整个形状的脱节分割.

blocks.en:
Existing part generators ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) may use cross-part attention to model relationships between parts, but still decode each part separately, allowing the same spatial region to be occupied by multiple parts ( i.e., penetration) or by no part at all ( i.e., gaps). They typically control the desired decomposition through a predefined number of parts, text prompts, or 2D image masks ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , offering indirect or limited control. Other methods support prompt-based 3D part segmentation ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2026 ) , which segments the mesh surface into parts based on 3D point prompts placed directly on the surface, but they typically predict a separate face mask independently for each prompt. While this provides direct 3D control over the desired parts, the resulting masks often require post-processing to resolve overlaps and are not constrained to jointly form a complete, non-overlapping segmentation of the object.
Consequently, both approaches may produce overlapping parts or missing components (see Fig. 3 ), rather than forming a coherent decomposition of the whole object.
blocks.zh:
现有部分发电机 (Lin等人,2025年;Tang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年a)可能会对各部分之间的模型关系使用跨部分的注意,但仍可以分别解码每个部分,允许同一空间区域被多个部分(即渗透)或完全没有部分(即缺口)占用. 它们通常通过预先确定的部件数量、文字提示或2D图像口罩来控制理想的分解(Zhu等人,2026a; Yang et al.,2025),提供间接或有限的控制. 其他方法支持即时立体分解(Ma等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2025年;Su等人,2026年),根据直接放在表面的3D点提示将网状表面分解成部分,但它们通常会单独预测每个提示的面罩. 虽然这对想要的部分提供了直接的3D控制,但由此产生的口罩往往需要处理后才能解决重叠问题,并且不受限制地共同形成一个完整的,非重叠的物体分割.
因此,这两种方法都可能产生部分重叠或缺失部分(见图3),而不是形成整个对象的一致分解。

blocks.en:
To address this, we formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape , where the resulting parts are exclusive , meaning their volumes do not overlap, and exhaustive , meaning their union recovers the entire volume of the object (see Eq. 1 for the formal definition).
The key to enforcing this structure is to define the decomposition jointly over the whole shape, rather than generating each part independently. Given an input image or mesh, users specify each desired part with a 3D point prompt, and we propose a model that decomposes the whole shape into the prompted parts. Our model builds on a pretrained 3D generation model ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ) and consists of three components: a shape latent backbone, a prompt encoder, and a part decoder. The shape latent backbone represents the input image or mesh as a shape latent capturing the entire geometry, while the prompt encoder maps each point prompt to a corresponding part token while attending to the shape latent. The part decoder then jointly scores the entire shape against all part tokens, assigning every query point within the shape volume to exactly one part. We further refine part boundaries at higher resolutions in a coarse-to-fine manner. This finally yields an exclusive and exhaustive partition by construction.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们将部分分解作为整个形状的联合分解,其中产生的部分是排他性的,意思是它们的体积不重叠,并且详尽无遗,意思是它们的结合恢复了整个物体体积(正式定义见Eq.1)。
执行这种结构的关键是将分解法联合于整个形状之上,而不是独立生成每个部分. 考虑到一个输入图像或网格,用户用3D点提示来指定每个想要的部分,我们提出一个将整个形状分解成激发部分的模式. 我们的模型以预先训练的3D生成模型(Hunyuan3D等人,2025年)为基础,由三个部分组成:形状潜伏骨干,即时编码器,以及部分解码器. 形状潜在主干代表输入图像或网格,作为捕捉整个几何的形状潜在,而即时编码器地图每点在注意形状潜在时会提示到相应的部分符号。 解码器然后将整块形状与所有部分的符号进行共分,将形状体积内的每个查询点都分配到准确的一部分. 我们以粗略至细的方式,在更高分辨率上进一步细化部分界限。 这最终导致通过建筑进行排他和彻底的分割。

blocks.en: By representing both image and mesh inputs in a shared shape latent space, our model supports three tasks in a unified way: image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation of mesh surface (see Fig. 1 bottom ). For generation, the model generates a closed mesh for each prompted part, while for segmentation, it assigns each mesh face to one of the parts. Moreover, our model offers interactive part decomposition, where users can flexibly control the decomposition by adjusting the number and locations of 3D point prompts (see Fig. 1 right ). We evaluate all three tasks on benchmark datasets ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and our method outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) generation and segmentation methods on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, while improving geometric compatibility between parts by an order of magnitude.
blocks.zh: 通过在共享的形状潜伏空间中同时代表图像和网格输入,我们的模型以统一的方式支持三个任务:图像对部分生成,网格对部分生成,以及网格表面的部分分割(见图1底部). 对于生成,该模型为每个被激发的部分生成一个闭合的网格,而对于分区,它将每个网格面分配到其中一个部分. 此外,我们的模型还提供交互部分分解,用户可以通过调整3D点提示符的数量和位置来灵活控制分解(见图1右方). 我们在基准数据集(Yang等人,2024年)上评价所有三项任务,我们的方法在全部三项任务的所有部分质量度量的生成和分解方法上都超过了最先进的(SOTA)生成和分解方法,同时按数量顺序提高各部分之间的几何兼容性.

blocks.en: In summary, we make the following contributions: 1. We formulate 3D part decomposition as a joint partition of the entire shape, identifying the overlap and missing components issues of existing part-level methods, yielding an exclusive and exhaustive partition by construction. 2. We introduce a promptable partition design that represents each user-specified part with a part token. Given a 3D point prompt per part, the model jointly assigns every point in the shape to exactly one prompted part, producing a complete partition of the shape. 3. By leveraging a shared shape latent, we support image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation within a unified framework, achieving SOTA performance and substantially improving geometric compatibility between parts.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们作出以下贡献: 1. 我们制定3D部分分解法,作为整个形状的联合分解法,查明现有部分一级方法的重叠和缺失部分问题,从而通过建造实现排他性和详尽无遗的分解。 2. 我们采用快速分区设计,代表每个用户指定的部分,并附有部分符号。 由于每个部分有一个3D点提示,该模型联合将形状中的每个点分配到一个精确的促动部分,产生一个完整的形状分割. 3. 通过利用共同的形状潜伏,我们支持图像到部分的生成、网络到部分的生成和在一个统一框架内的部分分割,实现SOTA性能,并大大改进各部分之间的几何兼容性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Promptable segmentation was popularized in 2D by SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , where a click yields a mask, and extended to concept prompts by SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) .
In 3D, Point-SAM ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) brings the click interface to point clouds, P3-SAM ( Ma et al., 2026 ) operates natively on meshes and merges per-click masks by suppression and flood fill, PartSAM ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) scales the design with a triplane encoder, and S 2 AM3D ( Su et al., 2026 ) adds a continuous scale signal.
Prompt-free methods cluster a learned feature field at a chosen count ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , lift SAM 2 masks from rendered views onto the mesh ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , or repurpose a generative model as a segmenter ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and PartObjaverse-Tiny ( Yang et al., 2024 ) is a common benchmark among them.
Each prompt is answered independently, so the masks may overlap or leave gaps, and in 3D, a mask is only a patch on the existing surface, not a closed part.
In contrast, our model answers all prompts jointly as one partition, and it not only segments the surface but also generates each part as a closed mesh.
blocks.zh:
SAM(Kirillov等人, 2023年)在2D中普及了可快速分解, 点击产生一个面具, 扩展至SAM 3(Carion等人, 2026年)的概念提示.
在3D中,Point-SAM(Zhou et al.,2025年)将点击界面带给点云,P3-SAM(Ma et al.,2026年)在母体上原生运行,通过压制和洪水填充将每个点击口罩合并,PartSAM(Zhu et al.,2026年b)将设计与trilane编码器缩放,S 2 AM3D(Su et al.,2026年)增加了连续的尺度信号.
快速法将选定的计数(Liu等人,2025年)中一个学习到的特征场集合起来,将SAM 2 口罩从所渲染的观点提升到网格上(Tang等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年),或将基因模型重新用作分层器(Li等人,2026年),Part Objaverse-Tiny(Yang等人,2024年)是其中的共同基准.
每个提示单独回答,因此口罩可能重叠或留下缺口,在3D中,口罩只是现有表面的补丁,而不是封闭的部分.
相比之下,我们的模型将所有提示作为一个分区共同回答,它不仅将表面分解,而且还将每个部分作为闭合网生成.

blocks.en:
Different from segmentation, part-level generation produces a closed mesh per part from a given image or mesh, building on whole-shape generators ( Li et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) .
They differ in what specifies the parts.
PartCrafter ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and PartPacker ( Tang et al., 2025 ) take only a part count and generate compositional latents, X-Part ( Yan et al., 2026 ) and FullPart ( Ding et al., 2026 ) take a box layout and generate each part within its box, OmniPart ( Yang et al., 2025 ) lifts 2D masks from the input image, CubePart ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) takes a list of part names, and HoloPart ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and UniPart ( He et al., 2026 ) work from a segmentation, given to the former and generated jointly with the geometry by the latter.
To our knowledge, these methods produce closed geometry, but none constrains one part to stay out of another or reports whether it does, and control is indirect, through counts, boxes, names, or masks.
We decode from a single whole-shape field with user points into exclusive and exhaustive parts.

与分层不同,部分层一代在整形发电机的基础上,从给定的图像或网格中每部分产生一个闭合网 (Li等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2026年;Hunyuan3D等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年;Gu等人,2026年).
具体内容不同。
PartCrafter(Lin等人,2025年)和PartPacker(Tang等人,2025年)只进行部分清点并产生成分潜伏物,X-Part(Yan等人,2026年)和FullPart(Ding等人,2026年)采取盒式布局,并在其箱内生成每个部分,OmniPart(Yang等人,2025年)从输入图像中提取2D口罩,CubePart(Zhu等人,2026年a年)从部分名称列表中取出,HoloPart(Yang等人,2026年)和UnPart(He等人,2026年)从一个分块中取出,交给前者并与后者的几何学共同生成.
据我们所知,这些方法会产生封闭的几何学,但没有任何一种方法能限制某一部分远离另一部分或报告,而控制是通过计数、盒子、名字或面具间接进行的。
我们从一个单一的全形状字段解码,用户点数变为专属和详尽的部分.

blocks.en:
An older line represents shapes using cuboids ( Tulsiani et al., 2017 ) , superquadrics ( Paschalidou et al., 2019 ) , learned convexes ( Deng et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2020 ) , or deformed spheres ( Paschalidou et al., 2021 ) .
These methods approximate shapes with a small set of geometric primitives rather than recovering the part decomposition, so their outputs are not directly comparable under our part-level metrics.
blocks.zh:
更古老的线条代表形状使用立体(Tulsiani等人,2017年),超方形(Paschalidou等人,2019年),学习对流(Deng等人,2020年;Chen等人,2020年),或变形球(Paschalidou等人,2021年).
这些方法与一小组几何原始的形状相近,而不是恢复部分的分解,因此它们的输出在我们部分级的度量下是无法直接比较的.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en:
Given a 3D object, represented either by a complete mesh or an image, together with user-specified 3D point prompts, we seek to decompose the object into one 3D part per prompt such that the parts form an exclusive and exhaustive partition of the object.
We first formulate part decomposition as a partition of the object, and then describe how point prompts specify the desired partition.

我们首先提出部分分解作为对象的分区,然后描述点提示如何指定想要的分区.

blocks.en: A 3D mesh admits valid decompositions at different granularities. To provide fine-grained and flexible control, we enable users to interactively control the decomposition by directly placing 3D point prompts on the object Ω \Omega , with one prompt for each desired part. In contrast to indirect controls such as text ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , 2D image masks ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , or part counts ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , 3D point prompts provide finer control over the entire object, including regions that may be occluded in a 2D view. Our model aims to decompose Ω \Omega to the prompted parts to produce a partition satisfying Eq. 1 . For generation , each prompt yields a closed part mesh, while for segmentation , each face is assigned a part label corresponding to a prompt.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 presents our unified model for promptable part generation and segmentation.
Given a mesh or an image together with N N user prompts, our model generates either N N closed part meshes or assigns one part label to each input face for the segmentation task.
Our model builds on a pretrained latent shape model ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ) and extends it with a prompt encoder and a part decoder.
For either input modality ( i.e. , image or mesh), the backbone provides shape latents 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} in a shared latent space.
For image input, the decoded whole mesh is used to place 3D prompts, while the same shape latents 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} are used for decomposition.
The prompt encoder processes user prompts by attending to 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} , producing one token 𝐏 ( L ) \mathbf{P}^{(L)} per part, and the part decoder jointly scores each query point 𝐱 \mathbf{x} against all part tokens, producing part assignments ℓ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \ell(\mathbf{x}) .
These part assignments ℓ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \ell(\mathbf{x}) derive the exclusive and exhaustive output parts Ω j {\Omega_{j}} by mesh extraction.

The shape backbone consists of shape encoders and an SDF decoder, as shown in Fig. 2 . The shape encoder maps the given image or mesh to shape latents, and the SDF decoder reconstructs a full mesh from shape latents.

We leverage pretrained alignment between the shape latents of the two inputs and perform the decomposition on the shared shape latent 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} , allowing the same prompt encoder and part decoder to operate on either input.

blocks.en:
We support both mesh and image inputs for part generation.
For either input, the predicted partition is converted into N N closed part meshes using Eq. 9 followed by per-part marching cubes.
For image input, prompts are placed on the generated mesh rather than on the image, so that parts on the back of the object, which the image does not show, can also be assigned.

对于图像输入,提示被放置在生成的网格上,而不是图像上,这样也可以分配到图像未显示的物体背面的部分.

4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
We compare against SOTA methods for part generation ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) and part segmentation ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Su et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
To keep the comparison as consistent as possible, we run all baselines using their official checkpoints and inference settings.
As these methods differ in inputs and training data, with some relying on private training data ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , our quantitative results serve as a proof-of-concept comparison under their respective released settings.
Generation methods ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) requiring a part count receive the GT part count;
CubePart ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) and OmniPart ( Yang et al., 2025 ) receive part names and 2D segmentation masks, respectively.
Unless stated otherwise, promptable methods ( Su et al., 2026 ) receive one point per GT part ( i.e. , K = 1 K{=}1 ), sampled uniformly from the corresponding part surface where it does not overlap with other parts. For image input, the point is sampled on the generated mesh surface after aligning the generated mesh to the GT mesh. Please refer to Appendix B for detailed baseline settings.

我们比较了部分世代的SOTA方法(Zhu等人,2026a); Yang等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年;Lin等人,2025年;Tang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年)和部分分离(Li等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026年b;Su等人,2026年;Ma等人,2026年;Liu等人,2025年).
为了尽可能保持比较的一致性,我们利用官方检查站和推断设置来运行所有基线。
由于这些方法在投入和培训数据上有所不同,有些方法依赖私人培训数据(Liu等人,2025年),因此,我们的量化结果可作为各自发布的环境下的概念证明比较。
需要部分计数的生成方法(Lin等人,2025年;Tang等人,2025年)得到GT部分计数;
CubePart(Zhu等人,2026a)和OmniPart(Yang等人,2025年)分别获得部分名称和2D分区口罩.
除非另有说明,否则即时方法 (Su等人,2026年)每GT部分获得1分(即K=1K{=}1),在与其他部分不重叠的情况下从相应部分表面统一取样. 对于图像输入,该点在将生成的网格与GT网格对齐后在生成的网格表面取样. 关于详细的基线设置,请参见附录B。

blocks.en:
We train on the public dataset HY3D-Bench ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2026 ) , which has 240 240 K assets with part-level labels.
The baselines were trained on their own datasets of comparable or larger size, almost all of which are not released.
We evaluate on PartObjaverse-Tiny ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , a widely used benchmark for 3D part decomposition, with 200 200 meshes and face-level part-instance labels, and we remove any assets from the HY3D-Bench training set that overlap with PartObjaverse-Tiny.
We use the same assets to evaluate all three tasks: a mesh for segmentation and mesh-conditioned generation, and a single rendered view for image-conditioned generation.
blocks.zh:
我们使用公共数据集HY3D-Bench(Hunyuan3D等人,2026年)进行训练,该软件拥有240 240 K资产,带有部分级别标签.
基线是根据它们自己的可比或较大规模的数据集培训的,几乎所有数据集都没有发布。
我们评价 PartObjaverse-Tiny(Yang等人,2024年),这是3D部分分解被广泛使用的基准,有200个 meshes和面级部分内置标签,我们取消了HY3D-Bench训练集中与PartObjaverse-Tiny重叠的任何资产.
我们使用同样的资产来评价所有三项任务:一个用于分割和网状条件生成的网格,以及一个用于图像条件生成的单一视图。

blocks.en:
We evaluate three aspects of the decomposition: part quality, whole-shape geometry, and part compatibility.
For part quality, pCD and pF1@ τ \tau measure matched-part Chamfer distance and surface F1; for segmentation, we additionally report face-level mIoU , where face correspondence is available.
For whole-shape geometry, CD and F1@.05 compare the union of generated parts with the ground-truth whole.
For part compatibility, we report inter-part penetration ( pen% ) and the fraction of closed parts ( wt% ); pen% measures violations of exclusivity, while pCD and pF1 also reflect failures of exhaustiveness (see Appendix B ).
Distances are reported at 10 − 2 10^{-2} scale in the normalized unit cube and averaged over assets. Inference time is measured per asset on one A100, and image predictions are ICP-aligned before evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价分解的三个方面:部分质量,全形状几何,以及部分兼容性.
关于部分质量, pCD 和 pF1 @\ tau 测量匹配部分 Chamfer 距离和表面 F1; 关于分区, 我们额外报告面层 mIoU, 在有面层对应。
对于全形状几何,CD和F1@.05将生成部件的结合与地面真实性整体进行比较.
关于部分兼容性,我们报告部分间渗透(笔%)和部分闭合部分(wt%);笔%测量违反排他性的情况,而pCD和pF1也反映了没有做到详尽无遗(见附录B)。
报告的距离为10 - 2 10 - 2 度。 每个资产按一个A100计量推断时间,图像预测在评价前与比较方案保持一致。

blocks.en: Our method faces challenges when decomposing extremely thin structures or large open surfaces (Appendix Figure 11 ), which may not enclose a well-defined volume and are therefore difficult to represent as solid parts. This limitation is partly due to the pretrained backbone, which struggles to represent and reconstruct such thin and open geometry. Improving the backbone’s representation of these geometries could extend our method to a broader range of shapes.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在分解极薄的结构或大面积的露天表面时面临挑战(附录图11),这些结构可能不包含一个定义明确的体积,因此难以作为固体部分来表示. 这种限制的部分原因是经过预先训练的骨干,它努力代表和重建如此薄薄而开放的几何. 改善骨干对这些几何的反映可以将我们的方法扩大到更广泛的形状。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce a unified promptable model for 3D part generation and segmentation that formulates part decomposition as a partition of the whole rather than a collection of independently generated parts.
By jointly assigning the whole among prompted parts, our model produces an exclusive and exhaustive partition by construction.
A shape can admit multiple valid decompositions; point prompts let users directly specify and control the desired decomposition.
A single model supports generation from meshes or images, as well as mesh segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art part quality while reducing part geometric incompatibility by over an order of magnitude.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了三维部分生成和分解的统一快速模型,将部分分解形成整体分割,而不是独立生成的部分集合.
我们的模型通过将整个部分共同分配给各部分,产生了一种排他性的、详尽无遗的建筑分割。
一个形状可以接受多个有效的分解;点提示让用户直接指定和控制想要的分解.
一个单一的模型支持从 mesh 或 图像中生成,以及 mesh 分割,实现最先进的部分质量,同时将部分几何不相容性降低到一个数量级以上.

We draw the queries of each asset from the pools of Sec. 3.2 , which allocate most of the budget to the surface and the seams between parts, while keeping a sparse, uniform pool for the rest of the bounding box.

培训其查询样本,而不是在网格上评估现场,因为大多数网格细胞都远离任何表面或缝隙,损失已经是零。
我们从3.2塞克的集合中抽取每个资产的查询,这些集合将大部分预算分配给地表和各个部分之间的接合,同时为其他边框保留一个稀少的,统一的集合.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the results for four assets; the leftmost panel shows the queries crowding the seams.
The prompt points, one to four per part, are drawn on each part’s surface where they do not overlap any other part.
Two prompt sets are drawn per asset, the balls and the cubes in the figure, and the consistency loss ℒ cons \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cons}} links their partitions.
blocks.zh:
图4显示4项资产的结果;最左边的面板显示的是挤压缝隙的查询。
每部分1至4个提示点是在每一部分的表面绘制的,它们并不与任何其他部分重叠。
每个资产绘制两套即时图,图中的球和立方体,一致性损失L cons\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{cons}链接它们的分区.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Training query sampling and prompt points. Small points are the sampled queries, colored by part; the larger markers are the prompt points, with balls and cubes marking two prompt sets for the same parts.
blocks.zh: 图4:培训查询抽样和快速点。 小点是采样的查询,颜色按部分排列;较大的标记是即时点,球和立方体标记两组即时的相同部分.

blocks.en:
Training runs on four A100 80GB GPUs for 3 days.
The learning rate follows a warm-up, hold, and decay schedule, rising over the first steps, staying constant for most of training, and decaying over the final fifth.
We keep an exponential moving average of the trained weights and use the averaged weights at inference, which removes the step-to-step variation of the raw weights without changing the model.
The base rate and the averaging constant are listed in Table 5 .
blocks.zh:
培训以4台A100 80GB GPU运行,为期3天.
学习率跟随热热,持和衰减时间表,在最初阶段上升,大部分训练时保持不变,在最后的第五阶段衰败.
我们保持了训练的重量的指数化移动平均值,并在推论时使用平均重量,这可以消除原始重量的步向变化,而不改变模型.
表5列出了基准率和平均常数。

blocks.en:
Every baseline runs its released checkpoint with its default settings.
The one exception is PartField: it evaluates 20 cluster counts per asset and selects the one with the highest mIoU against the ground truth. We instead use the annotated number of parts as a fixed count.
FullPart ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , and UniPart ( He et al., 2026 ) are discussed in Sec. 2 but not compared, since their inference code has not been fully released.
blocks.zh:
每个基线都以默认设置运行其已放行的检查站.
一个例外是Part Field:它评价每件资产20个集群计数,并根据地面真相选择一个mIoU最高的. 相反,我们使用附加说明的零件数量作为固定的计数。
FullPart (Ding et al., 2026),和UniPart (He et al., 2026)在sec.2中讨论,但没有进行比较,因为其推论代码尚未完全发布.

blocks.en:
We sample 2,000 2{,}000 points on the surface of every generated part with a fixed seed.
A probe is kept only if it is still inside its own part under the fast-winding-number sign ( Barill et al., 2018 ) ; a probe that passed through a thin part tells nothing about that part, and without this guard 99.98 99.98 percent of the flagged probes on a test set were of this kind.
Writing Q j Q_{j} for the surviving probes of part j j and Ω k \Omega_{k} for the solid bounded by part k k , a probe counts as penetrating if it lies inside any other part by the same test, which involves no grid or resolution, and pen = ∑ j # { 𝐪 ∈ Q j : ∃ k ≠ j , 𝐪 ∈ Ω k } ∑ j | Q j | , \mathrm{pen}=\frac{\sum_{j}\#\{\mathbf{q}\in Q_{j}:\exists\,k\neq j,\ \mathbf{q}\in\Omega_{k}\}}{\sum_{j}|Q_{j}|}, (16) in percent, per object and averaged over the benchmark.
Our parts partition one volume, so the residual we report is marching-cubes interpolation across a seam within one cell, whereas methods that decode each part as an independent field report interpenetration proper; for methods that output open shells the winding number is fractional and the value is approximate.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个固定的种子在每一个生成部分的表面取样2,000 2{,} 000点。
探测器只有在快风数标志(Barill等人,2018年)下仍然在自己的部分内时才保留;穿过薄片的探测器没有说明这部分的情况,没有这名警卫,在一组测试中标注的探测器有99.98 99.98%是此类.

我们的部分分割了1个卷,所以我们报告的剩余部分是横跨一个单元格内的缝隙的立方体插值,而将每个部分解码为独立字段报告插值本身的方法;对于输出打开贝壳的方法,旋转数为分数,数值为近似值.

blocks.en:
wt% is the share of generated parts whose mesh is closed, every edge shared by exactly two faces, per object and averaged over the benchmark.
A part that is not closed has no interior, so it cannot be moved or replaced as a solid, and a decomposition whose parts are not all closed does not partition the whole.
blocks.zh:
wt%是网格闭合的生成部件的份额,每个边缘由完全两个面子共享,每个对象并平均于基准.
未封闭的部分没有内部,因此不能作为固体移动或替换,其部分并非全部封闭的分解不能分割整体.

blocks.en:
A shape generated from an image lives in the generator’s own frame, so image-input methods are aligned to the ground truth before scoring, while mesh-input methods use the identity.
Both meshes are normalized by their bounding box, centered and scaled so that the longest side is one, and rigid ICP ( Besl and McKay, 1992 ) on 10 10 K surface points per side is run from 24 24 axis-aligned initial poses, without scale or reflection, keeping the transform of lowest cost.
The same transform is applied to the whole, to every part, and to the part-mesh vertices; the ground truth is only normalized.
blocks.zh:
由图像生成的形状生活在生成器自己的帧中,因此图像输入法在打分前与地面真理一致,而网格输入法则使用身份.
两种中间点都按其边框正常化,中央和缩放,使最长的一面是一面,每面10K表面点的硬化的比较方案(Besl和McKay,1992年)从24个24轴相配合的初始构件运行,没有规模或反射,保持最低成本的转换.
同样的转变适用于整体,每个部分,以及部分的梅斯顶点;地面真理只是正常化的.

blocks.en:
Generated parts are matched to ground-truth parts one to one by the Hungarian algorithm on the part Chamfer distance, and pCD and pF1 are computed on the matched pairs.
For mIoU, each face of the ground-truth mesh takes the label of the generated part that projects onto it, which gives a face labelling for generated parts and for predicted labels alike.
blocks.zh:
生成的部件通过Chamfer距离部分的匈牙利算法与地面真实部分1比对,pCD和pF1按匹配的对数计算。
对mIoU来说,地面-真实网格的每个面都将生成部分的标签标注在它上,这样可以给生成的部分和预测的标签都贴上面部标签.

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 结果

blocks.en:
Figure 5 bins the benchmark assets by their number of ground-truth parts and plots part quality per bin.
From a mesh, every generator loses accuracy as the part count grows, whereas ours stays close to its level on the simplest objects, so the margin is smallest on objects with a handful of parts and largest on those with more than twenty.
From an image, the ordering is the same, and OmniPart, the closest baseline on few parts, falls below PartPacker on the objects with the most parts.
A partition does not become harder to keep exclusive and exhaustive as N N grows, since every point is still assigned once, and the figure shows that accuracy follows.
blocks.zh:
图5按每桶地面真实部位的数量和地块部分质量来输入基准资产。
从网格上看,每个生成器都会随着部分数的增加而失去准确性,而我们的在最简单的物体上则保持接近其水平,因此,在有少数部件的物体上比值最小,在有二十多个部件的物体上比值最大.
从一个图像来看,命令是相同的,而OmniPart,几部分上最接近的基线,在对象上与大多数部分的PartPacker下方.
随着NN的增长,分区并不难做到排他性和详尽无遗,因为每个点仍然被分配一次,图中显示准确性随之而来.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Part quality against the number of ground-truth parts, from a mesh (left) and from an image (right), with part quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 图5:从网状(左)和图像(右),部分质量与地面真实部分的数量对比,并附有部分质量指标。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 extends Table 4 to K K from one to eight points per part.
Both metrics improve steeply from one to three points and then level off, and the gap between the backbones stays constant across K K , so extra points mainly remove the ambiguity of a single click rather than add information the backbone lacks.
Since the decoder cost is independent of K K , the measured end-to-end runtime changes negligibly.
blocks.zh:
图6将表4至KK部分从1至8点。
两个度量衡都从1到3分陡然改进,然后平平,骨干间的差距在K K之间保持不变,因此额外分数主要消除了一次点击的模糊性,而不是增加骨干缺乏的信息.
由于解码器成本独立于K K,所测量的端到端运行时间变化微乎其微.

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Segmentation quality against the number of prompt points per part K K , for both backbones, with mIoU (left) and pCD (right).
Both metrics improve steeply up to three points and change little beyond.
blocks.zh:
图6:两个主干线的分区质量与K K 部分的快速点数之比,分别为mIoU(左)和pCD(右)。
两种衡量标准都得到大幅改进,达到三点,变化不大。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 plots segmentation quality against inference time per asset.
Our model is the most accurate and under a second per asset.
The three points for K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } K\in\{1,2,4\} lie on a vertical line, since the points of a prompt are pooled into one token in the first encoder layer and the decoder cost does not depend on K K .
blocks.zh:
图7 土地分割质量与每项资产的推断时间。
我们的模型是最准确的 每件资产在第二秒下
K {{{{1,2,4}} K\in{1,2,4}的三分位于垂直线上,因为一个提示的点在第一个编码层中被集合成一个令牌,解码器的成本不依赖于K K.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Segmentation quality against inference time per asset, pF1@.05 (left) and pCD (right), with our model at K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } K\in\{1,2,4\} .
Ours is the most accurate at close to the lowest time, and raising K K improves quality at no cost in time.
blocks.zh:
图7:按资产推算时间划分的质量,pF1@.05(左)和pCD(右),我们的模型为K {{{1、2、4}K\in} 1,2,4\}.
我们的是在接近最低时间时最准确的,提高KK在不花费费用的情况下及时提高质量.

blocks.en:
Table 6 repeats the segmentation comparison on the PartNeXt evaluation set ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , a benchmark with finer and hierarchical part labels from a different source than PartObjaverse-Tiny.
Ours still leads every column among the methods, indicating that the gains transfer to a dataset from a different source.
blocks.zh:
表6重复了PartNEXt评价集(Wang等人,2025年)的分化比较,该基准的细度和等级部分标签来自不同来源,而不是PartObjaverse-Tiny.
我们仍然领导着方法中的每一个列,表明收益从另一个来源转移到一个数据集.

blocks.en: Table 6: Comparison of our method with SOTA methods for 3D part segmentation on PartNeXt. We evaluate part decomposition quality on face mIoU and on part-level pCD and pF1.
blocks.zh: 表6:我们的方法与SOTA方法在PartNEXt上的3D部分分割的比较. 我们用mIoU和部分级的pCD和pF1来评价部分分解质量.

blocks.en: We randomly sampled point prompts and repeated the experiment over five independent runs. The resulting standard deviations are small: 0.08 for pCD, 0.4 for both pF1@.01 and pF1@.05, and 0.3 for mIoU in the segmentation task. This indicates that the reported results are stable with respect to prompt sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们随机抽查点提示 并重复实验 在五个独立运行。 由此产生的标准偏差很小:pCD为0.08,pF1@.01和pF1@.05均为0.4,分区任务中mIoU为0.3. 这表明所报告的结果在迅速取样方面是稳定的。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Failure case and the effect of prompt placement. The same mesh is decomposed from one point per part placed near a contact between two parts (second column), from one point per part placed on the body of each part (third column), and from three points per part (fourth column).
blocks.zh: 图 8:失败案例和迅速安置的效果. 同一网格从两部分(第二列)接触附近放置的每部分一个点(第三列)分解,从每一部分(第三列)身体上放置的每部分一个点(第三列)分解,从每一部分(第四列)三个点分解.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 moves the parts of our results apart.
For generation, from an image or a mesh, every part is a closed mesh with its own cut faces, so the parts separate without any repair and reassemble into the whole, which is the use the introduction asks for.
For segmentation, the parts are the labeled faces of the input mesh, so they are open surfaces, and the exploded view shows where the label boundaries fall.
blocks.zh:
图9将我们的成果部分分开。
对于一代来说,从一个图像或一个网格,每个部分都是有自己切面的闭合网,因此这些部分在没有任何修复的情况下分开,重新组装成整体,这就是导言所要求的用途.
对于分化,部分是输入网格的标签面,因此是开阔的表面,爆炸的视图显示标签边界落地.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Exploded views of our results. Three assets per task, shown assembled and with the parts moved apart: part generation from an image (left), from a mesh (middle), and part segmentation of a mesh (right).
blocks.zh: 图9:对结果的探讨。 每个任务显示三件资产,组装在一起,部件分开移动:从图像(左)、从网(中)和网(右)部分分割。

blocks.en:
Figure 10 compares per-face labels on assets from both segmentation benchmarks.
The baselines err in two ways: merging small repeated parts into their neighbor, as with the cactus spikes and the keyboard keys, or fragmenting a single part into several, as with the roof and the piano body, while a partition with one prompt per part does neither.
blocks.zh:
图10比较了两个分割基准中资产面标签。
基线有两种错误:将小的重复部分合并到邻居中,如仙人掌钉和键盘键,或将一个部分分割成几个部分,如屋顶和钢琴体,而每部分一个提示的分区则两个部分都没有.

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Part segmentation on PartObjaverse-Tiny (top) and PartNeXt (bottom) . One point prompt per part, against the segmenters in Table 2 and the ground truth.
Ours keeps small repeated parts separate, such as the spikes, keys, and buttons, where the baselines merge or fragment them.
blocks.zh:
图10:Objaverse-Tiny(上部)和PartNEXt(下部)的部分分割。 一分一分,对表2中的分机 和地面真理。
我们把小的重复部分分开,如钉子、键和按钮,把基线合并或碎裂。

blocks.en:
Figure 12 extends Fig. 3 to twelve further assets from a mesh, and Fig. 13 to ten assets from an image.
The red regions, the volume claimed by two parts, appear at the joints of every baseline and are absent from ours, and where a baseline drops a part or returns a fragmentary object, ours keeps the decomposition of the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
图12将图3从网格扩大到12个,图13从图像扩大到10个。
红色区域,由两部分声称的体积,出现在每一基线的关节上,并且不在我们的基线中,当基线掉下一部分或者返回一个碎片物体时,我们的区域会保存地面真理的分解.

blocks.en:
Figure 11: Limitation on thin and open geometry. Large open surfaces and thin shells are poorly reconstructed by the pretrained VAE, and our decomposition consequently inherits these geometric errors.
From left to right: input, VAE reconstruction, our decomposition, and ground truth.
blocks.zh:
图11:对薄而开放几何的限制. 大型的露天表面和薄壳由预先训练的VAE重建不良,我们的分解因此继承了这些几何错误.
从左到右:输入,VAE重建,我们的分解,和地面真理.

blocks.en:
Figure 12: Part generation from a mesh on further assets . Compared against the generators in Table 1 , with the volume claimed by more than one part marked in red beside each result.
Every baseline interpenetrates at the joints, whereas our parts meet with negligible overlap and follow the ground-truth decomposition.
blocks.zh:
图12:关于其他资产的网格部分代号 与表1中的发电机相比,索赔数量超过一个部分,在每个结果旁边以红色标示。
每个基线在关节之间穿插,而我们的部分相交重叠微乎其微,遵循地面真实分解。

blocks.en:
Figure 13: Part generation from a single image on further assets . Compared against the generators in Table 1 , with the volume claimed by more than one part marked in red beside each result.
The baselines interpenetrate at the joints or return a fragmentary object, whereas our parts meet with negligible overlap and follow the ground-truth decomposition.
blocks.zh:
图13:从其他资产的单一图像中生成部分数据 与表1中的发电机相比,索赔数量超过一个部分,在每个结果旁边以红色标示。
关节上的基线相互穿透,或返回一个碎片物体,而我们的零件相交重叠可忽略不计,并遵循地面真实分解。

blocks.en:
Figure 14 decomposes objects at three granularities, from fewer to more parts, through the specification each method takes.
The top block shows one object, a robot arm, under every method.
A part count fixes how many parts PartField returns but not which, so the boundaries at each count are chosen by its clustering rather than by the user.
Part names pass through CubePart’s reading of them, and the number of parts it returns does not follow the number of names.
Masks for OmniPart are drawn on the image, so only parts visible in the view can be specified.
With one point per part, each added point splits off the part it sits on and leaves the other parts in place, so the user moves from a coarse to a fine decomposition by adding points.
The bottom block shows the same on two further objects, from the image alone.
blocks.zh:
图14通过每种方法的规格,在三个颗粒体上分解物体,从较少的部分到更多的部分。
顶部块显示一个物体,一个机器人臂,在每个方法下.
部分计数可以修正 部分域返回多少部分, 但不是哪个部分, 因此每个计数的边界是由其集群而不是由用户选择的 。
部分名称通过 CubePart 读取它们, 它返回的部分数量不跟随名称的数量 。
OmniPart的遮罩在图像上绘制,因此只能指定视图中可见的部分.
每部分加点后,每个加点会从它所坐的部分中分裂出来,而将其他部分留在原位,因此用户通过加点从粗细的分解到精细的分解.
底层块在另外两个对象上显示相同,仅从图像即可.

blocks.en:
Figure 14: Controlling the decomposition. Objects are decomposed at three granularities, from fewer parts to more parts, through the specification each method takes: a part count for PartField, part names for CubePart, 2D masks on the image for OmniPart, and one point per part for ours.
The top shows the same sample under every method; the bottom shows ours on two further samples.
blocks.zh:
图14 控制分解. 物体在三个颗粒处分解,从较少的部件到更多的部件,通过每种方法的规格:部分数为PartField,部分名称为CubePart,2D口罩在OmniPart的图像上,每个部分1分.
顶部在每种方法下显示相同的样本;底部在另外两个样本上显示我们的样本.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 shows the failure mode we observe most often.
An ambiguous prompt, a point placed where two parts touch, gives both prompts the same neighborhood, and the decoder merges the parts (second column).
A clear prompt, a point on the body of each part, avoids this (third column), and more points per prompt recover from an ambiguous one, since the pooled prompt then covers the part rather than one location (fourth column, as in Table 4 ).
blocks.zh:
图8显示了我们最经常观察到的失败模式.
一个模棱两可的提示,放在两个部分触摸的地方,使两个部分都得到相同的提示,解码器将部分(第二列)合并.
清楚的提示,即每一部分的正文上的一个点,可避免出现这种情况(第三栏),而且每次迅速从模棱两可的地方恢复得更多提示,因为集合提示涵盖部分而不是一个地点(如表4所示,第四栏)。
